zh.title: 國防部公布共機艦動態 偵獲7艦3船4架次 台海周邊未逾越中線
zh.summary: 國防部上午公布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲7艘共艦、3艘公務船及4架次共機持續在台海周邊活動，期間並無共機逾越台灣海峽中線，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
body: 國防部今天發布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止。
偵獲7艘共艦、3艘公務船及4架次共機，持續在台海周邊活動。
期間並無共機逾越台灣海峽中線。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan MND reports 7 Chinese warships, 3 official vessels, 4 aircraft sorties near strait; no median‑line crossing
en.summary: Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defense released a daily activity report covering 06:00 yesterday to 06:00 today, detecting 7 Chinese naval vessels, 3 official ships and 4 aircraft sorties operating around the Taiwan Strait. No Chinese aircraft crossed the median line, and the armed forces employed mission aircraft, ships and shore‑based missile systems for close monitoring and response.
body: The Ministry of National Defense today released a report on Chinese vessel and aircraft activity, covering the period from 06:00 yesterday to 06:00 today.
It detected 7 Chinese warships, 3 official vessels and 4 aircraft sorties continuing activities around the Taiwan Strait.
During the period no Chinese aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line.
The ministry emphasized that the armed forces used mission aircraft, ships and shore‑based missile systems for close monitoring and response.
